seoTitle: True Blood Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the True Blood test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Sookie, Bill, Eric, Jason, Lafayette, Tara, Sam, Pam or Jessica — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the mind reader, the Viking boss, or the one with a comeback for everything? Answer 12 everyday questions about loyalty, secrets and small-town life, and find out which True Blood character you are.

characters.name: Sookie Stackhouse
characters.title: The Mind Reader
characters.summary: Kind, stubborn and never as innocent as people assume. Trouble finds you, and you don't back down from it.
description: Like Sookie, you always seem to know what people are really thinking. She's a waitress at Merlotte's who can read minds, which makes dating very complicated.
You're sweeter than you look until someone crosses you. Sookie is polite and kind, but she won't be pushed around by anyone, vampires included.
You're more than people expect. Sookie finds out she's part faerie, and she ends up at the centre of almost everything supernatural in Bon Temps.
characters.flaw: You can't leave a mystery alone, even when it's clearly going to get you hurt.
characters.signature: A Merlotte's uniform, a sweet smile and a very good idea of what you're thinking.
characters.clashReason: they'd know what you were thinking before you'd said a word

characters.name: Bill Compton
characters.title: The Old-Fashioned Romantic
characters.summary: Polite, serious and a little bit haunted. You do things properly, and you love with your whole heart.
description: Like Bill, you've got old-fashioned manners. He was turned into a vampire during the Civil War, and he still acts like a Southern gentleman.
You hold on to who you used to be. Unlike most vampires, Bill still cares about his human life and the family he lost.
You take your responsibilities seriously. Bill was forced to turn Jessica into a vampire as a punishment, then found himself having to raise her.
characters.flaw: You brood about the past when you could be enjoying the present.
characters.signature: A pressed shirt, a family house full of history and a very long memory.
characters.clashReason: they'd take everything so seriously that you couldn't relax around them

characters.name: Eric Northman
characters.title: The Viking Boss
characters.summary: Confident, charming and always in charge. You know what you want, and you usually get it.
description: Like Eric, you walk into a room like you own it. He's a Viking who has been a vampire for over a thousand years.
You've got a head for business. Eric owns Fangtasia, the vampire bar in Shreveport, and he's the vampire sheriff of the area.
You've got a wicked sense of humour. Eric can be ruthless, but he's also playful, and he and Pam are fiercely loyal to each other.
characters.flaw: You assume the rules were written for other people.
characters.signature: A throne at the back of your own club and a smirk that means trouble.
characters.clashReason: they'd act like they owned the place, even when it's yours

characters.name: Jason Stackhouse
characters.title: The Lovable Hothead
characters.summary: Big-hearted, impulsive and up for anything. You don't always think it through, but you always mean well.
description: Like Jason, you act first and think later. Sookie's older brother works on the road crew, and he's a lot better at charm than at planning.
You get swept up in things. Jason joined the Fellowship of the Sun, an anti-vampire church, before working out he didn't believe in it.
You've got a good heart. Jason makes plenty of mistakes, but he'd do anything to protect his sister.
characters.flaw: You jump in with both feet and then ask where you landed.
characters.signature: A pickup truck, a cold beer and a plan you came up with thirty seconds ago.
characters.clashReason: they'd agree to something huge without asking you first

characters.name: Lafayette Reynolds
characters.title: The Fearless One
characters.summary: Bold, funny and completely unapologetic. You say exactly what you think, and you look fabulous saying it.
description: Like Lafayette, you're proudly yourself. He's the cook at Merlotte's and one of the boldest people in Bon Temps.
You've always got a side hustle. Lafayette sells vampire blood on the side, and he knows everybody's business.
You're tougher than anyone. Lafayette lives through being kidnapped and possessed, and he still never loses his sense of humour.
characters.flaw: You'd rather hide your pain behind a joke than admit you're scared.
characters.signature: Perfect eyeliner, a headscarf and a comeback for every occasion.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you the truth about yourself, loudly, in front of everyone

characters.name: Tara Thornton
characters.title: The Fighter
characters.summary: Blunt, fierce and fiercely loyal. You don't trust easily, but once you're on someone's side, you never leave it.
description: Like Tara, you've had to be tough. She had a hard, abusive childhood, and she doesn't let anyone push her around.
You say what you think. Tara is Sookie's best friend and a bartender at Merlotte's, and she has no patience for nonsense.
You survive things that would break other people. Tara is shot, and Pam turns her into a vampire to save her life.
characters.flaw: You get angry first and let yourself feel hurt much, much later.
characters.signature: A sharp tongue, a short temper and your best friend's back, always.
characters.clashReason: they'd say exactly what they thought of you, to your face

characters.name: Sam Merlotte
characters.title: The Steady One
characters.summary: Decent, loyal and reliable. You keep things running, even when you've got problems of your own.
description: Like Sam, you're the dependable one. He owns Merlotte's, the bar where half of Bon Temps works or drinks.
You keep some things to yourself. Sam is a shapeshifter, and for a long time almost nobody knows his secret.
You care about your community. Sam looks out for Sookie through everything, and he ends up as mayor of Bon Temps.
characters.flaw: You keep your own problems quiet until they turn into a much bigger problem.
characters.signature: A bar that always opens on time, a pickup truck and a secret or two.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep their secrets from you, then ask you to trust them

characters.name: Pam
characters.title: The Deadpan Queen
characters.summary: Cynical, stylish and devastatingly honest. You care about very few people, but you'd do anything for them.
description: Like Pam, you have very little patience for anyone. She runs Fangtasia with Eric, and her deadpan put-downs are some of the show's best lines.
You've always known how to run a business. Before Pam became a vampire, she was a brothel madam in San Francisco.
You're loyal where it counts. Pam is Eric's vampire child, and she'd follow him anywhere, even while complaining the whole way.
characters.flaw: You'd rather be thought heartless than admit how much you care.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a bored expression and a one-liner that ends the conversation.
characters.clashReason: they'd roll their eyes at everything you got excited about

characters.name: Jessica Hamby
characters.title: The Wild Child
characters.summary: Dramatic, emotional and hungry for life. You've got a lot of living to catch up on.
description: Like Jessica, you're making up for lost time. She grew up in a very strict home, and becoming a vampire felt like freedom.
You feel everything at full volume. Bill turned Jessica as a punishment, and she spent her first months as a vampire as a moody, impulsive teenager.
You grow up a lot. Jessica learns from her mistakes, and in the final episode she marries Hoyt.
characters.flaw: You act on every feeling the second you have it.
characters.signature: Red hair, big feelings and a lot of firsts to get through.
characters.clashReason: they'd make everything a drama, including your drama

questions.text: On your first day at a new job, a coworker tells you their whole life story. You...

options.text: Listen and take it all in. You're good at getting people to open up
Listen politely, and tell them nothing about yourself
Tell them your whole life story back. You're friends now
Give them some honest advice they didn't ask for
A candlelit dinner at home with slow music
A packed club where you know the owner
A bonfire, a cooler of beer and whoever turns up
Trying something you've never done before, then telling everyone about it

questions.text: Your friend is dating someone you're sure is bad news. You...

options.text: Tell them straight. You don't like this person and you won't pretend
Keep quiet, and be there for them when it goes wrong
Find out what this person is hiding before anyone gets hurt
Stay out of it. Their love life isn't your problem

questions.text: You're running late for work. You...

options.text: Call ahead and apologise properly. Being on time matters
Stroll in with a coffee. They'll live
Drive too fast, then come up with a wild story about why you're late
Take time over your outfit. If you're late, you might as well look good

questions.text: Someone insults you in front of a crowd. You...

options.text: Insult them back, louder and funnier
Get in their face. Nobody talks to you like that
Ignore them. You don't argue with people beneath you
Tell them, very sweetly, exactly what you think of them

questions.text: A friend asks you to help them move house on Saturday. You...

options.text: Turn up early with a truck and a plan
Say yes, forget, then turn up at the end in time for pizza
Say no. You don't do lifting
Turn up late, but with snacks and a playlist that gets everyone going

questions.text: You get landed with a big responsibility you never asked for. You...

options.text: Take it on. Once it's yours, it's your duty
Hand most of it to your most capable friend, and check in now and then
Complain about it nonstop, then do a brilliant job
Say no. You never signed up for this
A party island where the music never stops
A quiet cabin by a lake with a fishing rod
New Orleans, for the food, the music and the people-watching
Somewhere historic, with old houses and older stories

questions.text: You find out a friend has been keeping a big secret from you. You...

options.text: Feel hurt, but you get it. You've got secrets of your own
Blow up at them, then forgive them a week later
Aren't surprised. You'd already guessed
Feel betrayed, and make sure they know exactly how betrayed

questions.text: Someone tells you to tone yourself down to fit in. You...

options.text: Turn it up even more
Smile, nod, and carry on doing exactly what you want
Be polite about it, then ignore them completely
Go along with it. Life's easier when you fit in

questions.text: Vampires have just come out to the world, and one moves into your small town. You...

options.text: Go and say hello. Everyone deserves a fair chance
Keep your distance until you know what they want
Join the locals protesting about it, then change your mind a week later
Warn your best friend to stay well away from them

questions.text: You're a vampire who has been alive for centuries. You spend your nights...

options.text: Running a business, and quietly running the town
Trying to hold on to the person you were when you were alive
Shopping. Eternity is long, and so is your wardrobe
Making up for everything you missed out on as a human
